question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
    views,
    added_to_cart,
    left_in_cart,
    purchases
FROM (
    SELECT 
        v.product_id,
        v.views,
        a.added_to_cart,
        COALESCE(l.left_in_cart, 0) AS left_in_cart,
        COALESCE(p.purchases, 0) AS purchases
    FROM (
        SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS views
        FROM (
            SELECT e.visit_id, p.product_id, e.event_type
            FROM shopping_cart_events e
            JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
            WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
        ) pe
        WHERE event_type = 1
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) v
    JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS added_to_cart
        FROM (
            SELECT e.visit_id, p.product_id, e.event_type
            FROM shopping_cart_events e
            JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
            WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
        ) pe
        WHERE event_type = 2
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS left_in_cart
        FROM (
            SELECT pe.visit_id, pe.product_id
            FROM (
                SELECT e.visit_id, p.product_id, e.event_type
                FROM shopping_cart_events e
                JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
                WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
            ) pe
            WHERE pe.event_type = 2
            AND pe.visit_id NOT IN (
                SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
                FROM shopping_cart_events e
                JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
                WHERE p.page_id = 13 AND e.event_type = 3
            )
        ) pa
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) l ON v.product_id = l.product_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS purchases
        FROM (
            SELECT pe.visit_id, pe.product_id
            FROM (
                SELECT e.visit_id, p.product_id, e.event_type
                FROM shopping_cart_events e
                JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
                WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
            ) pe
            WHERE pe.event_type = 2
            AND pe.visit_id IN (
                SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
                FROM shopping_cart_events e
                JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
                WHERE p.page_id = 13 AND e.event_type = 3
            )
        ) pp
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) p ON v.product_id = p.product_id
)
ORDER BY product_id
